d:
What defines the perfect lady? Definitely ‘Ladio’ from ‘I’ does! Karky pens the perfect lines to describe the ever gorgeous Amy Jackson in this song. The track is fun and foot tapping number is sung by Nikita Gandhi, the song essays the characteristics of the woman who makes every head turn.
Song Name - Ladio
Movie - I
Singer - Nikita Gandhi
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Karky
Director - Shankar
Starring - Vikram, Amy Jackson
